sql: WITH window_reviews AS (SELECT r.review_score FROM reviews.order_reviews r JOIN orders.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = r.order_id JOIN orders.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.product_category_name = 'relogios_presentes' AND r.review_creation_date IS NOT NULL AND r.review_creation_date >= DATE '2018-01-01' AND r.review_creation_date < DATE '2018-02-01'), baseline_reviews AS (SELECT r.review_score FROM reviews.order_reviews r JOIN orders.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = r.order_id JOIN orders.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.product_category_name = 'relogios_presentes' AND r.review_creation_date IS NOT NULL AND r.review_creation_date >= DATE '2017-12-01' AND r.review_creation_date < DATE '2018-01-01'), window_avg AS (SELECT ROUND(AVG(review_score::DOUBLE), 4) AS value FROM window_reviews), baseline_avg AS (SELECT ROUND(AVG(review_score::DOUBLE), 4) AS baseline FROM baseline_reviews) SELECT value, baseline FROM window_avg, baseline_avg
